hypothesis: A fresh packaged macOS build can open the existing local model and show Codex and Claude Code conversation counts without reading message bodies or exposing private metadata to the renderer.
procedure: Build the pinned source revision on the owner MacBook.
Run all core and desktop tests before packaging.
Install the unsigned development DMG over the previous alpha.
Open Pocket i and inspect the MEMORY row.
Record only the two visible counts and whether the app remained responsive.
locked_success: The existing model remains available or can be reused without a second model download.
MEMORY leaves CHECKING and becomes READY or EMPTY.
The line Codex N · Claude N appears.
No conversation text, title, path or identifier appears in the UI.
known_boundary: This verifies packaging and count-only discovery. It does not retrieve evidence or answer from the Local Library.
